PED-52083 amount 872.31 payment at 15:32 -03:00. expires at 15:47 -03:00. Payment before expires, exact => "paid".

PED-46974 amount 1124.95 payment at 11:56 -03:00. expires at 12:14 -03:00. Payment before expires, exact => "paid".

All orders have a single payment exact amount, timely.
